versions.content: Error Name: EEP_E_ERASE_FAILED Short Description: EEPROM erase failed (HW) Long Description: The Eeprom module reports this error when EEPROM erase job fails due to a hardware error. Fail EEPROM erase job failed (see [SWS_Eep_00255]). Detection Criteria: Pass EEPROM erase job finished successfully (see [SWS_Eep_00244]). Secondary Parameters: N/A Time Required: N/A Monitor Frequency: Implementation specific
